topic.ar: Narrative Tenses: The Six Past Forms
topic.en: Narrative Tenses: The Six Past Forms

stem.en: John cooked, his guests had a good time, they left at midnight. Why the past simple?

explanation.ar: الماضي البسيط يسرد أحداثاً منتهية بترتيب حدوثها.
explanation.en: The past simple lists finished events in the order they happened.

stem.en: Just after midnight, John was looking at the mess. Why the past continuous?

explanation.ar: الماضي المستمر يؤطّر نشاطاً كان جارياً في تلك اللحظة الماضية.
explanation.en: The past continuous frames an activity that was already running at that past moment.

stem.en: His guests had just left. What does the past perfect show?

options.en: it was still in full progress

explanation.ar: الماضي التام يضع الفعل قبل اللحظة الماضية التي تُوصف.
explanation.en: The past perfect places the action before the past moment being described.

stem.en: He had been acting suspiciously for days. Which form is this?

explanation.ar: had been مع صيغة ing هي الماضي التام المستمر، نشاط قبل نقطة ماضية.
explanation.en: Had been plus the -ing form is the past perfect continuous, an activity before a past point.

stem.en: A man was arrested. Which form is this?

explanation.ar: was مع اسم المفعول هي الماضي البسيط للمجهول لحدث منتهٍ.
explanation.en: Was plus the past participle is the past simple passive of a finished event.

stem.en: The house had been burgled. Which form is this?

explanation.ar: had been مع اسم المفعول هي الماضي التام للمجهول لحدث أسبق.
explanation.en: Had been plus the past participle is the past perfect passive of an earlier event.

stem.en: With after and before, which tense is often optional?

explanation.ar: after و before توضحان الترتيب أصلاً، فيمكن للماضي البسيط أن يحل محل الماضي التام.
explanation.en: After and before already show the order, so the past simple can replace the past perfect.

stem.en: When Alice arrived, I was making a cake. This means...

options.en: I had not started it yet
I make it every single day
I was in the middle of it

explanation.ar: الماضي المستمر يدل على أن النشاط كان ما زال جارياً لحظة الوصول.
explanation.en: The past continuous shows the activity was still under way at the moment of arrival.

stem.en: I had made the cake by the time she came. This tells us...

options.en: I was still making it then
I had not begun it yet
I will make it much later

explanation.ar: الماضي التام يدل على أن الكعكة كانت جاهزة قبل وصولها.
explanation.en: The past perfect shows the cake was complete before she arrived.

stem.en: The film had started when we got to the cinema. This means...

explanation.ar: الماضي التام يضع البداية قبل وصولنا، أي أننا فوّتنا الافتتاح.
explanation.en: The past perfect places the start before our arrival, so the opening was missed.

stem.en: When I got to the garage, my car was being repaired. This means...

options.en: the car was for sale then

explanation.ar: was being مع اسم المفعول فعل مبني للمجهول كان جارياً في تلك اللحظة.
explanation.en: Was being plus the past participle is a passive action still running at that moment.

stem.en: He was sacked because he had been stealing for years. The continuous shows...

options.en: a plan for the far future

explanation.ar: الصيغة المستمرة تعرض السرقة المتكررة كنشاط مستمر قبل الطرد.
explanation.en: The continuous form presents repeated theft as an ongoing activity before the dismissal.

instructor.en: Asst. Prof. Dr. Haidar Akab Alwan
